snippet.title: Buzzin — TV with mobile phones - the Party Game Show
snippet.description:
Buzzin turns your TV into a live game show — and everyone's phone is the buzzer. 🎉
No downloads, no app, no accounts: the show runs on the big screen, players scan a QR code and join in about 3 minutes. Free to play.

In this round of the Quiz Show you'll see:
🎙️ A live host narrator calling every moment
🧠 Fast trivia with a speed bonus for quick answers
😈 Sabotage tricks — Stun, Freeze, Cloud and more to mess with your rivals
🏆 Eliminations, comebacks and a crowned winner
🎭 A cast of characters who roast the players between questions

Perfect for game night, parties, streams and family get-togethers — grab a group and see who really knows their stuff.
